The root cause of `android.security.keystore.UserNotAuthenticatedException` during `cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, key())` was that the Android Keystore AES key specification in [TokenVault.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-B-r4/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/TokenVault.kt#L20-L29) was configured with `setUserAuthenticationRequired(true)` and `setUserAuthenticationParameters(30, ...)`. 

Because user authentication was enforced at the hardware/keystore level on the symmetric key, any cryptographic operation (including token encryption upon sign-in) was blocked if the user had not authenticated via biometric or device credential within that time window (or on devices/emulators lacking a secure lock screen).

### Changes Made

In [app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/TokenVault.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-B-r4/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/TokenVault.kt#L20-L26):
- Changed `.setUserAuthenticationRequired(true)` to `.setUserAuthenticationRequired(false)`.
- Removed `.setUserAuthenticationParameters(...)`.
